Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

dest_domain.description: Terp destination domain / chain bind (32 bytes).

egress_zkid.description: Circuit id for Option D egress `proof_instance_verify` (production path). Lab / mock_verify ignores this. Default `None` keeps existing BridgeCfg JSON valid.

mock_verify.description: When true, proof verify is mocked (always-ok membership under claim flags). Production must set false and wire real verify.
